llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward guide for calling a video-generation API, with expected external data transfer but no hidden execution or persistence.

dimensions.detail: Network use and an API token are proportionate for a cloud video-generation service, though users should understand that submitted prompts and image URLs leave their environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only artifact/SKILL.md; there are no executable scripts, dependency installs, hooks, or local setup actions beyond setting an environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to authenticated API requests, but they do not include privacy warnings for prompts or image URLs sent to the provider.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request persistence, elevated privileges, local file access, background workers, credential-store access, or mutation of agent behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to generate AI videos through AceDataCloud's Hailuo API, and its capabilities are limited to example API calls for text-to-video, image-to-video, and task polling.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending video prompts, source image URLs, and related request data to AceDataCloud/Hailuo. Keep ACEDATACLOUD_API_TOKEN out of files and chat transcripts, and avoid submitting confidential prompts or internal image URLs unless your organization permits that provider.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The concern about prompts and image URLs being sent to AceDataCloud is valid as user guidance, but the artifact openly describes use of the AceDataCloud API and the transmission is core to the stated purpose.
[E1] expected: The authenticated POST to https://api.acedata.cloud/hailuo/videos is expected for this integration and is not evidence of hidden exfiltration or malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The token-handling guidance is minimal; this is a documentation weakness rather than a security-policy concern because the token is referenced as an environment variable and no hardcoded secret is present.
